title: Complete historical house registers as conditional paragraph programs
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. Encode the complete ordered condition structure of a real astrological house register, using shared typed operators and planet, house, time and aspect values. Each whole source house block becomes one whole target paragraph. Its conditions and explicit source references can identify a global key jointly; the fixed external table then retrieves complete prognoses without assigning free codes to their hapax words. No target fit or recovered meaning is claimed.

design.mechanism: Source is the complete Mercury-Saturn conjunction register in the1488 Astrolabium planum. Represent each printed house-heading block as an ordered list of guarded consequence bundles and explicit source references, preserving inherited arguments, conjunctions/disjunctions, qualifiers and conditional attachment alternatives. One concrete finite compiler candidate serializes the typed source AST in fixed prefix order, including scope delimiters, and maps each primitive operator or typed value to one complete written target group by ONE global injective dictionary. RETURN is a common operator whose source-bound path retrieves the entire associated prognosis; it has no separate clause-ID or outcome-word code. Source reference operands are actual printed house values, not invented graph links. This compiler is a new hypothesis, not an attested historical cipher, and is not yet selected or frozen.
design.unit: One complete printed source house block becomes one complete independently delimited target paragraph, with every written group consumed. Every source condition is represented, including unqualified base assertions and postposed qualifiers; no clause is dropped because its predicate is inconvenient. The source has12 printed blocks in this order: horoscope,2,3,4,5,{6,12},7,8,9,10,11,12. The combined6/12 block and the later12 reference remain separate observed blocks. A full-register experiment must specify a complete target paragraph container or a finite source-independent enumeration of whole containers and retain all source-block assignments. Already admitted complete-paragraph packets provide possible input units; existence of a matching twelve-block container is not established. No image ownership premise is required merely to formulate this writing model.
design.independent_binding: The source really reuses planet-pair, partile-conjunction, house, day/night, sign-quality and aspect roles. It explicitly sends house11 to the statements for5 and house12 to6. Whole rule addresses are often unique, but their primitive tests and values repeat within and across full blocks, so a repeated target group need not denote a repeated whole address. This avoids the immediate unique-address-to-whole-group collision of an opaque lookup model. Nested scope, typed argument sharing, source order and explicit references must all agree under the same dictionary.
design.source: Holding-library catalogue: https://collections.nlm.nih.gov/catalog/nlm:nlmuid-9410622-bk . Original1488 Augsburg Ratdolt edition, NLM identifier9410622,176 leaves; later historical witness, not proof of this wording before1450. The complete Mercury-Saturn register begins under its heading near the bottom of https://archive.org/download/9410622.nlm.nih.gov/page/n236.jpg , continues through https://archive.org/download/9410622.nlm.nih.gov/page/n237.jpg and ends near the top of https://archive.org/download/9410622.nlm.nih.gov/page/n238.jpg before the Mercury-Jupiter heading. All3 original canvases were inspected natively in this source-only review. OCR was navigation, not a validated transcription. Native image SHA256s: n236402b3cb296ceac92f30c232307a0a194bb9a68500ab320029cc6bb7e3c15ec95; n23710072585b30a6b27bba1c7dd47d67bc5b2fbbbb26712511e4b31ae59969f3b13. A complete source-block inventory is independently sealed; no complete prognosis transcription or target packet was created by this proposal.
design.concrete_source_block: The combined6/12 block is wholly present on original n237. Its common configuration is partile Mercury-Saturn conjunction in either named house. Its ordered statements comprise a day-qualified prognosis, a night-qualified prognosis, and a further day-or-night Mars-radiation condition explicitly mentioning square and opposition. Each returns a complete, different source consequence bundle. The next printed heading starts house7. The radiation phrase has a finite scope ambiguity; it must be preserved as literal structure or retained as explicit alternatives before fit.
design.source_uncertainties: The opening house7 assertion is unqualified, followed by an explicit NIGHT assertion; inventing DAY/ELSE would change the source. House4 and10 both print medio celi: keep that wording instead of correcting either location from canonical astrology. House8 has a postposed lunar condition whose attachment to the full night bundle versus its last subclause is unresolved. Houses2/4 mention sign qualities/nature and other-star configurations without enumerating values. Their global representation as source qualifiers or conditions must be fixed before target access. The source is an ordered set of historical claims, not automatically a mutually exclusive, total modern decision function.
design.identifiability: Enumerate all source-scope alternatives, complete block assignments and global token keys. Only conditions or source addresses shared by every surviving model are identified. Unknown semantic values need not be independently anchored before this joint test; identifiability is an outcome. Source automorphisms, unobserved primitives and indistinguishable address systems can remain. Even a unique condition key establishes at most a candidate external-table reading: the retrieved prognosis text is not thereby shown to be literally encoded in the manuscript. This ceiling does not itself refute the conditional writing model.
design.prediction: A strong future case is a complete independently delimited new house paragraph whose source structure is forced by the unchanged global key, complete-register order and source references. Predict every primitive and condition, and the resulting set of source addresses, before reading that paragraph; preserve all discovery-consistent alternatives. Source-only novelty can include a previously unseen conjunction of already recovered primitive tests, so no new hapax code is introduced. If an independent held container is unavailable, a complete finite UNSAT result may reject the declared whole-register compiler, while a fit remains exploratory. No held domain is currently established and no phase, scope, block boundary or source variant may be selected by held scores.
design.contrast: GDT207 tested a direct diplomatic letter map; GDT609's34-slot abbreviation profile is technical regularization, not this external rule register. GDT459/GDT473 use inherited nineteen-core working meanings and learned names; none are imported here. GDT614 concerns a fixed synthetic truth generator and its paid-card feasibility. GDT893 copies exact source-word runs, and895/896/898 test literal complete-entry/cell writing channels. The new source object is an externally fixed typed condition program with complete scoping and real references, not another Latin corpus for those decoders. Bounded route-check and duplicate navigation found related address/renderer ideas, not proof of originality; full selection review remains necessary.
design.scope: Raw architecture and concrete source lead only. Missing: independent source-scope agreement, exact global serialization, target whole-register container, complete model enumeration and prospective transfer. A source/key ambiguity is not automatically failure; a missing target ownership observation is not evidence against this model. No implementation, target fit, new Voynich image, inherited German gloss, source-list repair or meaning claim occurred. Parent may choose a different compiler before any experiment; this raw card authorizes none.
